Marketing.faq1A: Yes. Browsing, posting companion trips, connecting with guides, challenges, and sponsor perks are all completely free.
Marketing.faq2Q: How do I find travel companions?
Marketing.faq2A: Search by destination and dates on the homepage, or browse open trips on the Companions page. Apply to join trips that match your style.
Marketing.faq3Q: Is it safe to meet strangers?
Marketing.faq3A: We encourage verified profiles, mutual reviews, and in-app messaging before meeting. Always meet in public places and trust your instincts.
Marketing.faq4A: Complete missions like visiting landmarks, trying local foods, or exploring nature. Submit photo proof and earn points for the Hall of Fame.
Marketing.faq5Q: Can I become a local guide?
Marketing.faq5A: Yes. Update your profile to register as a guide, set your regions and rates, and respond to guide requests from travelers.
Marketing.faq6Q: How does the review system work?
Marketing.faq6A: After every trip or guide experience, both parties can leave mutual reviews. Ratings and trust scores are publicly visible on profiles.
Marketing.faq7Q: Can I cancel or change my trip posting?
Marketing.faq7A: Yes. You can edit or close your trip posting at any time from your dashboard. Applied members will be notified of any status change.
Marketing.faq8Q: How do I earn challenge points?
Marketing.faq8A: Visit challenge destinations, restaurants, or landmarks, then submit a photo as proof. Approved stamps earn you points toward the Hall of Fame leaderboard.
Marketing.faq9A: Yes — mytripfy is open to travelers from every country. Our community already spans 20+ countries with guides and companions actively joining every week.
Marketing.faq10A: For any issues, use the in-app messaging or email us at support@mytripfy.com. We typically respond within 24 hours.

ChallengeGuide.step1Desc: In the community feed you see other users' stamp photos. If you think the photo is from the wrong place, taken from the internet, or from a completely different location, tap the Dispute button.
ChallengeGuide.step2Desc: When you dispute, you stake 5 pts. This cost helps prevent abuse. You must give a concrete reason (at least 10 characters). If 3 or more people dispute the same stamp, it moves to the jury phase.
ChallengeGuide.step3Desc: Jurors are randomly selected from active users who have completed 5+ stamps in that category. They review the photo and dispute reason and vote ✅ Valid or ❌ Invalid within 72 hours.
ChallengeGuide.step4Desc: If 3+ jurors vote Invalid, the stamp is voided and points are deducted. If 3+ vote Valid, the dispute is dismissed and false reporters lose their staked points.
ChallengeGuide.penalty1Text: Deduction of that challenge's points only
ChallengeGuide.penalty2Text: Point deduction + ⚠️ Profile warning badge 30 days
ChallengeGuide.elig1Desc: Only users who have stamped at least 3 challenges can file a dispute.
ChallengeGuide.elig2Desc: Stamps older than 30 days cannot be disputed.
ChallengeGuide.elig3Desc: One person cannot dispute the same stamp twice.
ChallengeGuide.faq1Q: What if my dispute doesn't get 3 reporters?
ChallengeGuide.faq1A: If 3 people don't dispute within 30 days, the dispute is automatically dismissed and your staked points are refunded.
ChallengeGuide.faq2Q: Do I have to vote if I'm selected as a juror?
ChallengeGuide.faq2A: You can vote freely within 72 hours. If you vote, you get +2pt. No penalty for not voting, but no reward either.
ChallengeGuide.faq3Q: What should I do when my stamp is disputed?
ChallengeGuide.faq3A: You'll get a notification and can submit extra photos or evidence within 48 hours. (Coming soon.) Jurors may consider it when deciding.
ChallengeGuide.faq4Q: What happens if I file false disputes repeatedly?
ChallengeGuide.faq4A: Repeated false reports can lead to limited dispute rights. You also lose your 5pt stake each time the dispute is dismissed.
ChallengeGuide.faq5A: They are chosen at random from active users with 5+ stamps in that category. Followers of the reporter or stamper are excluded.

Privacy.intro: mytripfy ("we", "our", or "the Service") is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using mytripfy, you agree to this policy.
Privacy.s1Body:
We collect the following types of information:
• Account information: name, email address, profile photo, and password (stored securely via Supabase Auth).
• Profile information: nationality, travel level, biography, and any other details you choose to add.
• Travel content: companion posts, guide requests, trip records, reviews, and challenge stamps you create.
• Usage data: pages visited, search queries, and interactions within the Service (collected via server logs).
• Device information: browser type, operating system, IP address, and language settings.
Privacy.s2Body:
We use the information we collect to:
• Provide and operate the mytripfy platform.
• Match you with travel companions and local guides.
• Send service notifications, application updates, and messages within the platform.
• Improve our features and user experience.
• Detect and prevent fraud, abuse, or violations of our Terms of Service.
• Comply with applicable legal obligations.
Privacy.s3Body:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share information in the following circumstances:
• With other users: your public profile, posts, and reviews are visible to other registered users.
• With service providers: we use Supabase (database & auth), Vercel (hosting), and similar infrastructure providers who process data on our behalf under confidentiality agreements.
• For legal reasons: we may disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights and safety of our users.
• Business transfers: in the event of a merger or acquisition, your data may be transferred to the new entity.
Privacy.s4Body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. If you request account deletion, we will delete your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.
Privacy.s5Body:
You have the right to:
• Access the personal data we hold about you.
• Correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Request deletion of your account and personal data.
• Withdraw consent for optional data uses.
• Lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

To exercise these rights, please contact us at swbaek60@gmail.com.
Privacy.s6Body: mytripfy uses cookies and browser local storage to maintain your session, remember your language and currency preferences, and improve site performance. You can control cookie settings through your browser. Disabling cookies may affect some features of the Service.
Privacy.s7Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, access controls, and secure password hashing. However, no online service can guarantee absolute security. Please use a strong, unique password and contact us immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.
Privacy.s8Body: Our Service may contain links to third-party websites (e.g., social media profiles, external guides). We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before sharing any information.
Privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

AccountDeletion.lead: You can request deletion of your mytripfy account and the personal data associated with it. You do not need to be logged in to use this process.
AccountDeletion.step1Body: Send an email from the address registered on your mytripfy account (if you still have access to it). If you no longer have access, send from any email and include as much detail as possible so we can verify your identity (e.g. full name, approximate signup date, profile URL or username).
AccountDeletion.step2Body:
• Subject line: "Account deletion request" or "Data deletion request"
• State clearly that you want your account and personal data deleted
• Include your registered email address if different from the sending address
AccountDeletion.step3Body: After we verify your request, we will delete your account and associated personal data within approximately 30 days, except where the law requires us to retain certain records (e.g. tax or fraud prevention). Some anonymized or aggregated data that cannot identify you may be retained.
AccountDeletion.step4Body: We use Clerk for authentication. After we delete your data in mytripfy, you may also remove mytripfy from the list of connected apps in your Google / Apple / Facebook account settings if you wish.

100-countries-challenge.title: What is the 100 Countries Challenge?
100-countries-challenge.excerpt: A gamified bucket list with 1,600 missions across 16 categories — countries, food, landmarks, and more.
100-countries-challenge.metaDesc: Learn how the mytripfy 100 Countries Challenge works — 1,600 travel missions, photo verification, points, and Hall of Fame ranking.
100-countries-challenge.keywords: 100 countries challenge, travel bucket list, mytripfy, travel gamification
100-countries-challenge.intro: The 100 Countries Challenge on mytripfy is more than a checklist. It is a community-driven game that turns every trip into proof, points, and stories you can share.
100-countries-challenge.section1Body: Choose from countries, attractions, restaurants, foods, drinks, museums, nature, islands, animals, festivals, golf, fishing, surfing, skiing, scuba, and art galleries. Each category has 100 curated missions with real-world destinations.
100-countries-challenge.section2Body: Visit the place, take a photo on-site, and submit it as a stamp. Community review and dispute rules keep the feed honest. Approved stamps earn points toward your profile and the global Hall of Fame.
100-countries-challenge.section3Title: Why it helps you travel more
100-countries-challenge.section3Body: Challenges push you to explore beyond the obvious — a local market, a hidden beach, a museum you would have skipped. Many members say the challenge changed how they plan trips.
100-countries-challenge.section4Body: Sign up free, open the Countries category, and pick your first nation. You do not need to visit 100 countries overnight — progress is tracked mission by mission.
100-countries-challenge.ctaBody: Browse the Countries challenge and submit your first stamp after your next trip.

find-travel-companion.title: How to find a travel companion safely
find-travel-companion.excerpt: A practical guide to matching by destination, dates, and travel vibe on mytripfy.
find-travel-companion.metaTitle: Find a Travel Companion | mytripfy Guide
find-travel-companion.metaDesc: Step-by-step guide to finding travel companions on mytripfy — search, apply, chat, and meet safely with trust scores and reviews.
find-travel-companion.keywords: find travel companion, travel buddy, solo travel partner, mytripfy
find-travel-companion.intro: Traveling with the right companion can cut costs, reduce loneliness, and unlock experiences you would miss alone. Here is how to do it well on mytripfy.
find-travel-companion.section1Body: Before browsing, know your destination, dates, budget level, and pace (relaxed vs packed). Use the Trip Matcher quiz on your profile so others can find you faster.
find-travel-companion.section2Body: Search companions by country and city on the homepage or Companions page. Read the full post, check the host's trust score and reviews, then send a short application explaining why you are a good fit.
find-travel-companion.section3Body: Use in-app messaging to align on daily plans, accommodation, and split costs. Video call once if possible. Never share passwords or send money outside agreed channels.
find-travel-companion.section4Body: First meet in public. Share your itinerary with someone at home. After the trip, leave an honest mutual review — it helps the whole community.
find-travel-companion.ctaBody: See who is traveling to your destination, or post your own trip and let companions come to you.

become-local-guide.title: How to become a local guide on mytripfy
become-local-guide.excerpt: Turn your city knowledge into meaningful connections — setup, pricing, and tips for great reviews.
become-local-guide.metaDesc: Register as a local guide on mytripfy — set regions, hourly rate, respond to guide requests, and earn trust through reviews.
become-local-guide.keywords: become local guide, tour guide side income, mytripfy guide
become-local-guide.intro: If you love showing visitors your city, mytripfy lets you connect directly with travelers — no agency middleman required.
become-local-guide.section1Body: Enable guide mode in profile settings. Add regions and cities you cover, languages you speak, and photos that show your personality. Complete profiles get more requests.
become-local-guide.section2Body: Set an hourly rate in your currency or offer free meetups if you are building reputation. Be clear about what is included — walking tour, food recommendations, transport help.
become-local-guide.section3Body: Travelers post guide requests with dates and interests. Apply with a personal message referencing their trip. Fast, friendly replies win more bookings.
become-local-guide.section4Body: After each experience, both sides leave reviews. High trust scores appear higher in search. Disputes are handled fairly if something goes wrong.
become-local-guide.ctaBody: Update your profile and start receiving guide requests from travelers worldwide.
